page.layout: One page of text in one column: a Hebrew-Latin dictionary, each entry a paragraph beginning with a Hebrew headword in larger type. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left, gathering signature at the bottom left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Vexillum erigamus, Psalm.20.6. Niph.Partic. נִדְגָּלוֹת Vexillata copia, Cant.6.3.
דָּגָן m. Frumentum, Genef.27.28. Constr. דְּגַן שָׁמַיִם Et frumentum cœlorum, Psal.78.24. Aff. דְּגָנְךָ Frumentum tuum, Deut.7.13.
דָּגַר Collegit, Jer.17.11. וְדָגְרָה Et colliget, Jesa.34.15. Chaldaicum est.
דָּד m. Uber, Mamma: Plural. Constr. דְּדֵי בְתוּלֵיהֶן Mammas virginitatis illarum, Ezech.23.3. Aff. דָּדַיִךְ Mammas tuas, v.21.

הִתְדַּדָּה Hithp. הִתְדַּדָּה Vagari, Incedere, Gradi, sed sensim & leniter: Futur. אֶתְדַּדֶּה Sensim incedam, Jes.38.15. pro אֶתְדַּדֶּה: Cum Aff. אֶדְדֶּךָּ Gressurus sum cum illis, Psal.4.2.5. pro אַדְּדָה עַמָּהֶם Progrediar cum illis, juxta Hebræos.

דְּהַב Chald. Aurum, דִּי דְּהַב טַב Ex auro bono, Dan.2.v.32. ubi exemplaria in folio habent *, quod pravum, ut liquet ex forma emphatica. Emphat. רֵאשֵׁה דִּי דְּהַבָּא Caput auri, Dan.2.v.38. Hebr. זָהָב commutatis ו & ד.
דַּהֲבָה f. Aurea, Aurifica, Inaurata vel Auri cupida, Jesa.14.4. in Hebræo, ubi propheta Regem Babylonia voce Babylonica irridet, ejus divitias carpens.
דָּהַם Niph. נִדְהַם Defatigari. Partic. נִדְהָם De-fessus, Defatigatus, Jer.14.9. Kimchi in Com. Obstupefactus, qui nescit quid agendum.
דָּהַר Plausit; sed de Equis tantum dicitur, qui citato cursu terram plaudunt: וְסוּס דֹּהֵר Et equi plaudentis, Nah.3.2.
תִּדְהָר Teda, arbor refinam ferens, Jesa.41.19.
* דּוּב Ursus: vide supra in דב.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek are copied from the scan and may contain small errors in vowel points and dagesh, which are hard to make out at this resolution. Marked forms need checking against a larger image: the headword of the Niph. entry in line 1, the Hithpael and Futur. forms in the Hithpael entry, and the Aram. forms in the דְּהַב entry. The entry "דַּהֲרוּרוֹת" is a best reading. The asterisk in the דְּהַב entry is printed as a reference mark in the text. Signature read as "I 3". Long s rendered as s.
